text:
Maya: Customer SonicEdge wants a 2-week POC for their sonic-llama-7b-custom. Asks: SentencePiece tokenizer, 4-bit quant, embeddings + reranker, KMS, and committed per-call pricing.
Noel: Catalog check: we have sonic-llama-7b-v2 but only stock spm. Request tokenizer.model and vocab file. Also ask for example prompts so we can validate tokenization.
Arjun: Quant path supports SPM. Caveat: when special tokens are added at high IDs, kv-cache alignment can break. We should run a token-id diff once they send artifacts.
Sienna: Pricing note: hosted ~ $0.010/1k gen tokens; 2-GPU dedicated pool estimate ~$3.5k/mo. For a 2-week POC we can do a temporary committed credit. Need expected token/day to firm numbers.
Maya: Action items: 1) Ask SonicEdge for tokenizer.model + 300-line sample. 2) Run perf for 4-bit vs fp16 (seq=1024, batch=4). 3) Fill security QS; confirm if PHI present.
Arjun: Running quick perf now. Snippet: ```bash
redwood perf --model sonic-llama-7b-v2 --quant 4bit --seq 1024 --batch 4
# p50 58ms/token
# p95 245ms/token
``` Logs -> https://redwood.internal/tickets/22468
Arjun: If p95 ~245ms I recommend small dedicated or prefix caching for chat. I can add a small tokenizer remap adapter if their SPM adds <10 special tokens.
Noel: Also flag: embeddings dimension mismatch could happen; ask if they require 1024 or custom dim. We can add a projection head for POC but call latency rises ~10%.
Sienna: Security ops: KMS + VPC ok; for SAML we need IdP metadata. If they want 180-day log retention that's enterprise addendum territory.
Maya: I'll request artifacts and the QS now. ETA customer reply EOD.
redwood-ci: Ticket RW-22468 created and assigned to #sales and #eng-ml.
Noel: I'll prep a short pricing options PDF and a 3-step POC timeline to attach (tokenization -> perf -> security).
Maya: Perfect. If they send the tokenizer today Arjun can run the token-id diff and we can confirm kv-cache compatibility quickly. Thanks :thumbsup:
